'''A''' [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who lived in the final [[Time/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] took the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Tohno]] as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], teaching her studies in architecture and engineering, as well as the Jedi ways. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Death/Legends|died]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and Tohno was left without a Master.
